name: Gmail
headline: Start today. Going live depends on one question: does your agent read email?

firstTest.text: About 20 minutes to a working sign-in with your own app

production.text: Send only: about 1-2 weeks. Read email: several weeks to a few months

approvalWait.text: Scope review typically 3-5 business days; restricted scopes add a yearly security assessment

whoCanRegister.text: Any Google account can create the app. Going live needs a verified domain, a homepage and a privacy policy.

testMode.text: No verification in testing, but only test users you add, max 100 over the app's lifetime. Refresh tokens expire after 7 days.

actions.label: Send email
actions.review: Brand check + scope review + demo video

steps.title: Book a security assessment lab
steps.detail: Only if your agent reads email. It is the slowest step, so start it on day one.

steps.title: Create a Google Cloud project
steps.detail: console.cloud.google.com → New project. Keep it separate from other work.

steps.title: Set up the consent screen
steps.detail: Google Auth Platform → Get started: app name, support email, audience External, contact email, agree to the User Data Policy.

steps.title: Add Gmail permissions
steps.detail: Data Access → Add or remove scopes. Gmail scopes only appear after the Gmail API is enabled; pasting the scope address also works.

steps.title: Add your pilot users
steps.detail: Audience → Test users. Anyone not listed is blocked with Error 403.

steps.title: Create the OAuth client
steps.detail: Clients → Web application → add your callback address. The secret is shown once; store it in your hosting settings.

steps.title: Prepare brand verification
steps.detail: Verify your domain in Search Console, publish a homepage and a privacy policy on that domain, add them on the Branding page.

steps.title: Write scope justifications
steps.detail: One sentence per scope on why a narrower one won't work.

steps.title: Record the demo video
steps.detail: Show the sign-in and every scope in use, with the client ID visible in the address bar.

steps.title: Submit for verification
steps.detail: Verification Center → Prepare for verification. Answer reviewer emails promptly.

blockers.title: Users click 'Back to safety'
blockers.fix: Google highlights Back to safety on the unverified-app warning. Tell pilot users to click Continue.

blockers.title: Pilot users lose access after a week
blockers.fix: Refresh tokens expire after 7 days in testing. Plan reconnects or finish verification first.

blockers.title: Users untick a permission
blockers.fix: Google shows one checkbox per permission. Check which scopes came back and ask again for missing ones.

blockers.title: Callback domain you can't verify
blockers.fix: Redirect domains become authorized domains. Use a callback on your own verified domain.

blockers.title: Vague scope justification
blockers.fix: Name the feature that needs each scope and why a narrower scope fails.

agentCan: Fill the consent screen and scope forms from your product details
Draft scope justifications and the demo video script
Check your site for a privacy policy and homepage before you submit
youDo: Sign in to Google Cloud and agree to Google's policies
Verify your domain (DNS or Search Console)
Store the client secret in your hosting settings
Pay for and complete the security assessment

drafts.title: Scope justification: gmail.send
drafts.body: Our assistant sends replies that the user has reviewed and approved in our app. gmail.send is the narrowest scope that allows sending; we do not read, modify or delete existing mail.

drafts.title: Scope justification: gmail.readonly
drafts.body: Our assistant summarises the user's support inbox so they can triage faster. It needs message bodies, which gmail.metadata does not include. We never modify or delete mail.

drafts.title: Demo video script
drafts.body:
1. Show the app homepage and privacy policy link.
2. Click Connect Gmail; show the consent screen with the client ID in the address bar.
3. Show each permission in use: a summary (read) and a sent reply (send).
4. Show how a user disconnects.

unconfirmed: End-to-end time for restricted scopes (Google says only 'several weeks')
